events.title: Pitch Submission Deadline
events.description: Final deadline for teams to submit their written pitch deck and supporting materials for review ahead of the OnCampus Competition. Late submissions cannot be scored, so build in buffer time before the cutoff.

events.title: OnCampus Competition Day
events.description: The chapter's flagship pitch competition, where teams present live in front of a judging panel for a chance to advance to the Hult Prize Regional round. Open to the campus community to attend and watch.

events.title: Results Announcement
events.description: Winners of the OnCampus Competition are announced, along with which team(s) will advance to represent UC Davis at the next stage of the Hult Prize competition.

events.title: National Competition (for advancing teams)
events.description: The advancing team(s) compete against other university chapters nationally, with top performers moving on toward the global Hult Prize accelerator and summit.
